# telnyx_sim_card_group_action (Data Source)

An asynchronous action on a SIM card group, such as setting its private wireless gateway.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date-time indicating when the resource was created.
- `record_type` (String)
- `settings` (Attributes) A JSON object representation of the action params. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings))
- `sim_card_group_id` (String) The SIM card group identification.
- `status` (String)
- `type` (String) Represents the type of the operation requested.
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date-time indicating when the resource was updated.
